scope: Introduced scalar elastic model; no actual dog-engagement, backlash-impact, damping, friction, manufacture, life or six-axis capture certificate.

relations.clock: axial step = net screw lead / tooth count; does not include installation, thread, bearing, wear or temperature errors

force_margin_requirement.scope: Necessary one-sign initial-force condition in the instant-offset proxy, not a sufficient dynamic/strength certificate.

kinematic_cost.scope: Ideal reversible work only. Both differential thread interfaces carry axial load; actual friction, preload, bearings, capture, gearing and heat must be paid.
